The opt-in identity layer (docs/ACCOUNTS.md): one account, many sign-in identities (password / Google / GitHub / Telegram), hashed sessions, email verification, TOTP 2FA, and the /auth/* + /login surface — all OFF unless the addon fragment is enabled.

:PROPERTIES:
:CUSTOM_ID: accounts/resolve-social-identity!
:FILE: src/graphden/accounts/core.clj
:LINE: 169

The heart of account-LINKING: a social sign-in resolves to an existing identity, auto-links onto an account that owns the same VERIFIED email, or creates a fresh account — in that order. One person, many sign-in methods, one stable account-id for authz.

* 2. mint-session!
:PROPERTIES:
:CUSTOM_ID: accounts/mint-session!
:FILE: src/graphden/accounts/core.clj
:LINE: 212
:MINS: 1.8
:END:

Sessions are rows, not JWTs: the raw token exists exactly once (the return value); storage keeps only its SHA-256. ~kind~ overloads the same row for verify links and pending-2FA steps — kinds outside nil/"api" never authenticate, so a verify link can't become a bearer.

* 3. accounts-provider
:PROPERTIES:
:CUSTOM_ID: accounts/accounts-provider
:FILE: src/graphden/accounts/provider.clj
:LINE: 64
:MINS: 0.9
:END:

The module's AuthProvider: bearer OR the HttpOnly gd_session cookie (an OAuth redirect can't carry a bearer) → an org-AGNOSTIC principal. Org is deliberately absent — the tenancy layer resolves it from membership, which is what keeps this module open-core.

- source :: [[file:../../../src/graphden/accounts/provider.clj::(defn accounts-provider][src/graphden/accounts/provider.clj:64]]

* 4. make-router
:PROPERTIES:
:CUSTOM_ID: accounts/make-router
:FILE: src/graphden/accounts/routes.clj
:LINE: 509
:MINS: 8.9
:END:

The whole HTTP surface as one route-collection Ring router: password + social + telegram callbacks, verify links, identities list/unlink, TOTP enroll/confirm/login-step, and the /login + /account pages. Installed before the graph router; returns nil to fall through, so an instance without the addon never sees it. The page/email PRESENTATION renders through the injected graph seam (~app.auth-pages~ on the platform ctx) with the built-in Clojure shell as the graph-outage fallback — see ~graph-page~ just above.

- source :: [[file:../../../src/graphden/accounts/routes.clj::(defn make-router][src/graphden/accounts/routes.clj:509]]

* 5. valid?

RFC 6238 in ~100 lines: base32, HOTP, a ±1-step skew window and a constant-time compare, verified against the RFC's reference vectors. The enrollment/confirm flow that uses it lives in accounts.core.
